field_principles.strong_reasoner_self_verify_auroc: The subsumer's own self-verification quality — the baseline the moat must add value beyond.
field_principles.residual_catch_rate: Of the errors the strong reasoner MISSES, the fraction Carnot's ensemble catches — the moat's REAL definition per DT-P2 (error-independence, not AUROC parity).
field_principles.error_overlap_jaccard: Jaccard of the two systems' caught-error sets; LOW overlap = independent (moat survives), HIGH overlap = subsumable (moat fragile).
field_principles.carnot_ensemble_auroc: For reference vs the strong reasoner; deliberately NOT the headline metric here — error-independence is.
field_principles.n_step_labeled_items: N>=100 so the residual catch rate is not noise (and >=30 per partition cell).
field_principles.model_specs: Records the actual SOTA GGUF invoked (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B) so the strong-reasoner claim is auditable.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Standard methodology fields; a 35B GGUF pass over N items takes minutes — duration floor 60s, implausibly short = fabrication.
